Analysis specification for a single PNU analysis

Source: R/RunAnalyses.R
PnuAnalysis.Rd

Bundles all step-specific settings for one run of the PNU pipeline. Create with [createPnuAnalysisArgs()].

Super class

AbstractSerializableSettings -> PnuAnalysis

Public fields

analysisId

Unique integer identifier.

description

Human-readable label.

pnuCohortArgs

[PnuCohortArgs] object; `NULL` when `pnuDataList` is supplied to [runPnuAnalyses()].

studyPopulationArgs

[StudyPopulationArgs] object.

tcpsArgs

[TcpsArgs] object; `NULL` = uniform PS (0.5).

matchingArgs

[MatchingArgs] object.

outcomeModelArgs

[OutcomeModelArgs] object.

bootstrapArgs

[BootstrapArgs] object; `NULL` = skip bootstrap.

balanceArgs

[BalanceArgs] object; `NULL` = skip balance.

Methods

Public methods

  • PnuAnalysis$new()

  • PnuAnalysis$validate()

PnuAnalysis$new()

Construct from named arguments or a JSON string.

Usage

PnuAnalysis$new(
  analysisId = 1L,
  description = "",
  pnuCohortArgs = NULL,
  studyPopulationArgs = NULL,
  tcpsArgs = NULL,
  matchingArgs = NULL,
  outcomeModelArgs = NULL,
  bootstrapArgs = NULL,
  balanceArgs = NULL,
  json = NULL
)

Arguments

analysisId, description, pnuCohortArgs, studyPopulationArgs, tcpsArgs, matchingArgs, outcomeModelArgs, bootstrapArgs, balanceArgs

See factory.

json

JSON string from `toJson()` (restores only primitive fields).

PnuAnalysis$validate()

Validate all fields using checkmate.

Usage

PnuAnalysis$validate()

PnuAnalysis$toJson()

Serialise to JSON (primitive fields only).

Usage

PnuAnalysis$toJson()

Details

Nested settings objects contain Cyclops objects that are not JSON-serializable; only `analysisId` and `description` are round-tripped.
